references.text: This text describes the same journey where the Israelites departed from Punon (Oboth is mentioned as the next stop). This is the parallel account of the wanderings through the wilderness.
The previous verse describing how they departed from Zalmon and camped at Punon, the previous encampment before Oboth.
The next verse describing the continuation of the journey from Oboth to Iye-Abarim, on the border of Moab.
